patchOf:
root = Stack([caseHeader, partiesHeader, partiesBlock, timelineHeader, timelineTabs, issuesHeader, issuesAccordion, glossaryHeader, glossaryTable, disclaimer])
caseHeader = CardHeader("Hollis Renewables v. Marrow Logistics", "Fictional case · Superior Court of Eastbrook · Contract dispute")
partiesHeader = InlineHeader("Parties", "The people and entities involved")
partiesBlock = Stack([plaintiffCard, defendantCard, counselCard], "row", "m", "stretch", "start", true)
plaintiffCard = Card([plaintiffInfo, plaintiffList])
plaintiffInfo = IconText(plaintiffIcon, "info", "m", "Hollis Renewables LLC", "Plaintiff · Solar energy developer", true, "horizontal")
plaintiffIcon = Icon("sun", "energy")
plaintiffList = EntityList([{left: "Role", right: "Buyer under supply agreement"}, {left: "Location", right: "Brightfield, Eastbrook"}, {left: "Counsel", right: "Dana Okafor"}], "default")
defendantCard = Card([defendantInfo, defendantList])
defendantInfo = IconText(defendantIcon, "warning", "m", "Marrow Logistics Inc.", "Defendant · Freight and warehousing", true, "horizontal")
defendantIcon = Icon("truck", "transport")
defendantList = EntityList([{left: "Role", right: "Seller and carrier of panel shipments"}, {left: "Location", right: "Port Ashford, Eastbrook"}, {left: "Counsel", right: "Rafael Quill"}], "default")
counselCard = Card([judgeInfo, judgeList])
judgeInfo = IconText(judgeIcon, "neutral", "m", "Hon. Miriam Tallis", "Presiding judge", true, "horizontal")
judgeIcon = Icon("gavel", "legal")
judgeList = EntityList([{left: "Court", right: "Superior Court of Eastbrook"}, {left: "Docket No.", right: "EB-24-01187"}, {left: "Filed", right: "March 4, 2024"}], "default")
timelineHeader = InlineHeader("Procedural Timeline", "Key events from filing to ruling")
timelineTabs = Tabs([tabEvents, tabDeadlines])
tabEvents = TabItem("events", "Events", [eventSteps])
eventSteps = Steps([s1, s2, s3, s4, s5])
s1 = StepsItem("Mar 4, 2024 · Complaint filed", "Hollis alleges Marrow failed to deliver 40% of contracted panel shipments.")
s2 = StepsItem("Apr 18, 2024 · Answer and counterclaim", "Marrow denies breach and counterclaims for unpaid storage fees.")
s3 = StepsItem("Jul 9, 2024 · Discovery closes", "Parties exchange shipping manifests, emails and warehouse logs.")
s4 = StepsItem("Oct 22, 2024 · Summary judgment motion", "Hollis moves for partial judgment on the delivery shortfall.")
s5 = StepsItem("Jan 15, 2025 · Ruling", "Court grants partial judgment on liability; damages set for trial.")
tabDeadlines = TabItem("deadlines", "Deadlines", [deadlineTable])
deadlineTable = Table([Col("Deadline", deadlineNames), Col("Date", deadlineDates), Col("Status", deadlineStatus, "string")])
deadlineNames = ["Expert disclosures", "Pretrial conference", "Damages trial"]
deadlineDates = ["Mar 3, 2025", "May 12, 2025", "Jun 30, 2025"]
deadlineStatus = ["Complete", "Scheduled", "Scheduled"]
issuesHeader = InlineHeader("Disputed Questions", "What the court must decide")
issuesAccordion = Accordion([issue1, issue2, issue3])
issue1 = AccordionItem("issue-1", "1. Did the contract require delivery of 100% of panels?", issue1text)
issue1text = TextContent("Hollis argues the supply agreement's delivery schedule was mandatory. Marrow contends the clause allowed shortfalls covered by a force majeure provision.")
issue2 = AccordionItem("issue-2", "2. Does the force majeure clause apply to port congestion?", issue2text)
issue2text = TextContent("Marrow claims a 9-week port backlog qualifies. Hollis responds that congestion was foreseeable and therefore excluded.")
issue3 = AccordionItem("issue-3", "3. Are storage fees recoverable as damages?", issue3text)
issue3text = TextContent("Marrow's counterclaim seeks fees for warehousing delayed panels. The court must decide whether those costs were caused by Hollis's own delay in pickup.")
glossaryHeader = InlineHeader("Glossary", "Common legal terms used in this case")
glossaryTable = Table([Col("Term", glossaryTerms), Col("Meaning", glossaryMeanings)])
glossaryTerms = ["Plaintiff", "Defendant", "Summary judgment", "Force majeure", "Counterclaim", "Discovery"]
glossaryMeanings = ["The party who brings a lawsuit.", "The party being sued or answering the claim.", "A ruling decided without trial because no material facts are disputed.", "A contract clause excusing performance due to unforeseeable events beyond a party's control.", "A claim filed by a defendant against the plaintiff in the same case.", "The pretrial process of exchanging evidence between parties."]
disclaimer = Callout("neutral", "Fictional example", "All parties, courts, and details are invented for illustration and do not describe any real case.")
